segments.name: Exploration and mining
segments.description: Engages in metal exploration and mining activities in Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region of the PRC.
segments.evidence: After the sale of Precise Space-Time Technology Limited and the disposal of the wastewater treatment segment in July 2023, the Company is solely engaged in metal exploration and mining activities in Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region of the PRC, including exploring for lead, silver and other nonferrous metal.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company sold PST Technology and discontinued its rural wastewater treatment segment, leaving exploration and mining as its sole segment.
changes.evidence: We no longer operate in the rural wastewater treatment segment following the sale of PST Technology in July 2023, which was one of our two reportable operating segments in addition to exploration and mining.
